geometry.note: Kept 'approximate' (reasons in the method) even though the length check below passes against a rank-2 official source.

method: OpenStreetMap way 289305285 ('913 - ASG Ring' [sic], place=locality, with OSM tags linking it to the Alternating Gradient Synchrotron), a single closed way of 20 nodes, used verbatim. BNL's own central-campus-map building key independently confirms Building 913 as 'AGS Ring' (map coordinate H3). Accuracy stays at the ring-road/imagery-traced level (30 m or coarser) and confidence 'approximate' despite a passing length check: the way carries place=locality rather than a tunnel, building or man_made tag, so it reads as a hand-drawn boundary around the visible ring in aerial imagery, not an official technical alignment (the RHIC ring way, by contrast, is explicitly tagged tunnel=yes and indoor=yes).
